description: War, betrayal and loss push Xena and Gabrielle through some of their darkest conflicts, including Caesar, Dahak and the consequences of choices neither can easily undo.

s03e01.description: In “The Furies”, Xena and Gabrielle face a new conflict shaped by myth, war or Xena’s past, testing how far redemption can survive the consequences of violence.
